title: The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2605.22417v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. We further unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) methods, and Taylor expansion, clarifying the connections among them and explicitly identifying the baseline for each method. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect m

translated_title: 模型解释中被忽视的基线
translated_abstract: 我们观察到，现有的模型解释方法通常忽略了基线，而这种忽视往往会导致不精确甚至错误的解释。在本文中，我们重新表述了模型解释任务以及模型解释结果的解释原则，以证明基线的重要性。我们进一步统一了基于梯度的方法、积分梯度方法和泰勒展开，阐明了它们之间的联系，并明确指出了每种方法各自的基线。在此基础上，我们分析了相关模型解释方法（IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map）中存在的缺陷和错误。我们主张通过归因结果与归因目标之间的归因误差来精确评估模型解释结果的质量，而不是采用有缺陷的评估方法，例如基于边际效应或完美模型假设的评估方法。
tldr: 本文揭示了模型解释中被忽视的基线问题，统一了梯度法、积分梯度法与泰勒展开并明确各方法的基线，分析了IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等现有方法的缺陷，并倡导采用归因误差来精确评估解释结果的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the neglected baseline in model interpretation, unifies gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients, and Taylor expansion with explicit baselines, identifies flaws in existing methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map), and advocates precise evaluation of interpretation quality through attribution error.
